_note: § Area guide for SEO and for helping guests. Only well-established facts about Skala and Kefalonia. Verify anything you are not sure about with web search; if still unsure, leave it out. No prices except where given. Natural, specific, useful. Each body is 2–4 sentences unless noted.

hero.title: § 4–8 words: Skala and south-east Kefalonia, the way locals know it
hero.subtitle: § 1–2 sentences

intro.title: § 'Why Skala'
intro.body: § 2 paragraphs (max 120 words): long beach on the south-east coast, calm sea, sunrise side; village rebuilt after the 1953 earthquake; relaxed main street; Roman villa with mosaics; good base for Poros, Katelios, the east coast and day cruises to Ithaca and Zakynthos.

air.title: § 'By air'
air.body: § Kefalonia airport (EFL) ~33 km, about 45 minutes by car or taxi; we can arrange a taxi.

ferry.title: § 'By ferry'
ferry.body: § Poros port (verify ferries to Kyllini, Peloponnese) ~ a short drive from Skala; also Sami (ferries to Patras/Ithaca — verify).

around.title: § 'Getting around'
around.body: § walkable village; a car or scooter helps for beaches further away; KTEL buses (verify).

when.title: § 'When to come'
when.body: § 2–3 sentences: season May–October; June and September are warm and calmer; July–August busiest; cruises run in season.
